node.statement: For each j, T->Phi(T) tensor I_F is CP because Phi is CP and tensoring with an identity representation preserves complete positivity; compression A->Lambda_j^*A Lambda_j is CP. Their composition Upsilon'_j is CP. At every matrix level, positivity in the finite direct sum B=direct-sum_j B(L_j) is coordinatewise, so Upsilon'=(Upsilon'_j)_j is CP.
